\begin{center}\LARGE Die astronomischen Tafeln des Muḥammed ibn Mūsā al-Khwārizmī\par\vspace{3mm}\large in der Bearbeitung des Maslama ibn Aḥmed al-Madjrīṭī und der lateinischen Uebersetzung des Athelhard von Bath\par\vspace{4mm}\normalsize edited by H. Suter on the preliminary work of A. Bjørnbo and R. Besthorn\\(Copenhagen: A. F. Høst \& Søn, 1914)\par\vspace{3mm}the Wellcome Library copy, Internet Archive b24872489, JP2 images 0000–0295\par\vspace{4mm}\large the Latin text and tables of the recension, line by line\end{center}\vspace{6mm}
\noindent The Arabic \textit{Zīj al-Sindhind} of Muḥammad ibn Mūsā al-Khwārizmī is lost. Suter’s book edits a derivative line of it: the recension of Maslama ibn Aḥmad al-Majrīṭī, in the Latin translation ascribed to Adelard of Bath (twelfth century). It is not al-Khwārizmī’s text. The book is transcribed in two files: the Latin text and tables of the recension, with the editor’s apparatus, and Suter’s German matter, his foreword, introduction, commentary, corrections, glossary and index, with the pages that carry no text.
\par\smallskip\noindent Every printed line of the book is one line here, in the order of the images of the Wellcome copy (Internet Archive b24872489), with its number in the margin and its anchor AK07-J\#\#\#\#-L\#\# (JP2 image, line); the lines of the footnotes follow below a short rule with the anchors N\#\#. The text is transcribed letter for letter as printed, with its punctuation, italics and spaced type, and the words divided at the ends of the lines. The folios of the manuscripts that the edition prints in the margin are set in the margin. Bookplates, stamps, shelfmarks and notes written in this copy are recorded in the page records, not reproduced. Where the print is in error, the transcription keeps it; the critical notes at the end, which are not part of the transcription, propose the correction.
\par\smallskip\noindent The Latin text and Suter’s edition are in the public domain, and this transcription is dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). It is AI-integrated work (Claude); no person has proofread it. This file holds 5230 printed lines and 1127 lines of the footnotes from 154 images.\par\clearpage

\EdLc{11}{AK07-J0048-L11}{\textbf{Cap. 22. De apparitione lunae vigesima nona die ad vesperum\textsuperscript{2}).}}{\MargL{C 71\textsuperscript{r}, O 128\textsuperscript{v}}}

\EdL{13}{AK07-J0048-L13}{praescriptae sunt. Nunc vero de lunae appararitione competens est subnotare. Cum}{}
\EdL{14}{AK07-J0048-L14}{itaque\textsuperscript{4}) quaeretur, utrum die mensis lunaris\textsuperscript{5}) vigesima nona ad vesperum visibilis}{}
\EdL{15}{AK07-J0048-L15}{sit luna an non\textsuperscript{6}), erit locus solis et lunae secundum ipsius\textsuperscript{7}) diei meridiem, addita}{}
\EdL{16}{AK07-J0048-L16}{etiam sex horarum examinatione\textsuperscript{8}), inveniendus\,; sicque habebitur eorum locus\textsuperscript{9})}{}
\EdL{17}{AK07-J0048-L17}{secundum eiusdem diei vesperum\textsuperscript{10}). Deinde locus lunae a loco solis quo numero}{}
\EdL{18}{AK07-J0048-L18}{habundat diligenter notandus\textsuperscript{11}). Quod\textsuperscript{12}) si fuerit luna \textit{shemeli}\textsuperscript{13}), id est ex hac}{}
\EdL{19}{AK07-J0048-L19}{parte septentrionali\textsuperscript{14}), erit ipsius lunae latitudo differentiae praenotatae coacervanda\textsuperscript{15}),}{}
\EdL{20}{AK07-J0048-L20}{si vero \textit{genubi}, id est ex illa parte, meridionalis scilicet sive australis\textsuperscript{16}), eadem\textsuperscript{17})}{}
\EdL{21}{AK07-J0048-L21}{eidem\textsuperscript{18}) subtrahenda\textsuperscript{19}), eritque distantia definita\textsuperscript{20}). Deinde vero in tabulam sub-}{}
\EdL{22}{AK07-J0048-L22}{scriptam introducemur per lunae signum, et signi faciem eorumque angularis nota-}{}
\EdL{23}{AK07-J0048-L23}{bitur conventus. Eo itaque conventu si distantia supradicta maior fuerit, eodem}{}
\EdL{24}{AK07-J0048-L24}{vespere expectatum lumen apparebit\,; sin autem minor, non\textsuperscript{21})\,; si vero\textsuperscript{22}) aequalis,}{}
\EdL{25}{AK07-J0048-L25}{oculo quidem perspicaci sanoque aere vix apparebit.}{}
\EdLp{26}{AK07-J0048-L26}{Quod si vigesimi septimi diei hora matutina\textsuperscript{23}) quaestio inciderit, solis item}{}
\EdL{27}{AK07-J0048-L27}{atque lunae secundum eiusdem diei meridiem loco notato, quantumque sex horis}{}
\EdL{28}{AK07-J0048-L28}{attinet subtracto, tractabuntur cetera modo supradicto\textsuperscript{24}).}{}
\EdLp{29}{AK07-J0048-L29}{Callendum autem ut horae supradictae secundum statum praesentis regionis}{}

\FrameHead{0050}{p. 18}{0050}{p. 18}
\EdL{1}{AK07-J0050-L01}{tota mentis intentione amplectatur. Hinc etenim tam examinationis\textsuperscript{1}) additio et}{}
\EdL{2}{AK07-J0050-L02}{subtractio quam argumentorum introductio, sed et ipsa locorum inventio ratione}{}
\EdL{3}{AK07-J0050-L03}{subnixa\textsuperscript{2}) est. Si quis autem in quaestionem duxerit, quare argumentis talibus talia}{}
\EdL{4}{AK07-J0050-L04}{\textit{elgeib}\textsuperscript{3}) ascribantur atque e converso, sciat huius rationis causam ab \textit{elmagesti}}{}
\EdL{5}{AK07-J0050-L05}{\Sperr{Ptolomaei} petendam\textsuperscript{4}) esse.}{}
\EdLc{6}{AK07-J0050-L06}{\textbf{Cap. 24. De latitudine cuiuslibet habitationis invenienda.}}{\MargL{C 72\textsuperscript{v}, O 130\textsuperscript{r}}}
\EdLp{7}{AK07-J0050-L07}{Hactenus de argumentis atque\textsuperscript{5}) elgeib quae eis accedunt\textsuperscript{6}) scriptum\textsuperscript{7}) sit.}{}
\EdL{8}{AK07-J0050-L08}{Nunc vero consequens esse videtur, ut quomodo singularum regionum latitudo, id}{}
\EdL{9}{AK07-J0050-L09}{est spatium quod est inter eos et \textit{Arin}\textsuperscript{8}), reperiri queat edisseratur.}{}
\EdLp{10}{AK07-J0050-L10}{Sole itaque in primo gradu arietis\textsuperscript{9}) vel librae existente, eius \textit{artifa}\textsuperscript{10}), id est}{}
\EdL{11}{AK07-J0050-L11}{altitudo, quam maxima in meridie loci praesentis esse potest\textsuperscript{11}), a nonaginta gradi-}{}
\EdL{12}{AK07-J0050-L12}{bus\textsuperscript{12}) subtrahatur, residuumque praesentis loci latitudinem esse necesse est\textsuperscript{13}).}{}
\EdL{13}{AK07-J0050-L13}{Quod si sol quidem in alio signo fuerit, erit eius \textit{artifa} meridianum, subtracta sibi}{}
\EdL{14}{AK07-J0050-L14}{solis\textsuperscript{14}) ipsius obliquatione, si fuerit illa \textit{shemeli}, addita vero si fuerit \textit{genubi}\textsuperscript{15}), a}{}
\EdL{15}{AK07-J0050-L15}{nonaginta minuendum\,; huius ergo\textsuperscript{16}) diminutionis reliquum latitudinem loci prae-}{}
\EdL{16}{AK07-J0050-L16}{sentis ostenderet\textsuperscript{17}).}{}
\EdLp{17}{AK07-J0050-L17}{Amplius per \textit{elmahwar}, id est polum, idem approbatur. Notabitur enim per}{}
\EdL{18}{AK07-J0050-L18}{astrolabium quanta sit in loco praesenti poli altitudo, tantum enim\textsuperscript{18}) eiusdem loci}{}
\EdL{19}{AK07-J0050-L19}{latitudinem esse necesse est.}{}
\EdLp{20}{AK07-J0050-L20}{Et poli quidem altitudo sic habebitur. Quaelibet enim stella earum dico, quae}{}
\EdL{21}{AK07-J0050-L21}{occasum nesciunt, notanda erit, eiusdemque\textsuperscript{19}) \textit{elmuhit}, id est circumferentia, per}{}
\EdL{22}{AK07-J0050-L22}{ipsius altitudinem maximam et minimam rimanda\textsuperscript{20}). Sic ergo diametro habita\textsuperscript{21})}{}
\EdL{23}{AK07-J0050-L23}{eiusdem centrum polum esse palam erit\textsuperscript{22}).}{}

\EdL{1}{AK07-J0051-L01}{signorum ortus in loco latitudine carente consideretur\textsuperscript{1}). In illis enim regionibus}{}
\EdL{2}{AK07-J0051-L02}{quae latitudinem habent, diversis temporibus diversi eorum ortus et occasus}{}
\EdL{3}{AK07-J0051-L03}{reperiuntur. Quae etiam celerius oriuntur tardius occidunt et e converso. In eis}{}
\EdL{4}{AK07-J0051-L04}{vero quae latitudine carent, ut regio\textsuperscript{2}) \textit{Arin}, in qua semper dies aequales\textsuperscript{3}), omni}{}
\EdL{5}{AK07-J0051-L05}{tempore eorum ortus uniformis\textsuperscript{4}). In omni tamen regione in meridie quidem sic}{}
\EdL{6}{AK07-J0051-L06}{oriuntur ut\textsuperscript{5}) in \textit{Arin}. Cum igitur quaeretur\textsuperscript{6}) signorum ortus, \textsuperscript{7}) qualis sit secundum}{}
\EdL{7}{AK07-J0051-L07}{circulum aequinoctialem\textsuperscript{8}) obliquationis solis, quae quidem gradus XXIII atque}{}
\EdL{8}{AK07-J0051-L08}{dakaicas LI obtinet, \textit{elgeib} notandum erit, diceturque \textit{elgeib primum}. Deinde \textit{elmeil},}{}
\EdL{9}{AK07-J0051-L09}{id est obliquatio, a XC detrahetur\textsuperscript{9}), quod autem\textsuperscript{10}) remanserit argumentum, eius}{}
\EdL{10}{AK07-J0051-L10}{\textit{elgeib} quaerendum erit diceturque \textit{elgeib secundum}. Postea vero eius signi, quod in}{}
\EdL{11}{AK07-J0051-L11}{qnaestione est, obliquatio ultimi gradus argumentum ponendum est, eiusque \textit{elgeib}}{}
\EdL{12}{AK07-J0051-L12}{considerandum, diceturque \textit{elgeib tertium}. Postremo vero ipsa eadem ultimi gradus}{}
\EdL{13}{AK07-J0051-L13}{obliquatio a XC minuenda, residuoque argumento posito eius ipsius \textit{elgeib} inveniendum,}{}
\EdL{14}{AK07-J0051-L14}{diceturque \textit{elgeib quartum}. His autem\textsuperscript{11}) ita habitis \textit{elgeib tertium} in \textit{elgeib secundum}}{}
\EdL{15}{AK07-J0051-L15}{ducendum est, quodque inde producetur secundum\textsuperscript{12}) \textit{elgeib primum}\textsuperscript{13}) dividendum\,;}{}
\EdL{16}{AK07-J0051-L16}{atque quod ei accidet in sexaginta ducendum. Quod autem inde producetur secundum\textsuperscript{14})}{}
\EdL{17}{AK07-J0051-L17}{\textit{elgeib} | \textit{quartum} dividendum erit\textsuperscript{15}). Quod vero\textsuperscript{16}) ei accidet, ad eius arcum modo supra}{\Marg{O 130\textsuperscript{v}}}
\EdL{18}{AK07-J0051-L18}{dicto revertatur\textsuperscript{17}). Ipse itaque arcus ortum ipsius signi verbi gratia arietis iuxta}{}
\EdL{19}{AK07-J0051-L19}{circulum aequinoctialem\textsuperscript{18}) sua quantitate ostendit\textsuperscript{19}). Similiter autem et\textsuperscript{20}) de aliis}{}
\EdL{20}{AK07-J0051-L20}{inquirendum est. Ea tamen cautela praestricta, ut si supra tauro quaestio inciderit,}{}
\EdL{21}{AK07-J0051-L21}{supradictis expletis praeceptis a postremo arcu id quod arieti attinet minuatur\,;}{}
\EdL{22}{AK07-J0051-L22}{cetera vero ortui tauri parificentur\textsuperscript{21}). Item si quando geminorum ortus tractabitur,}{}
\EdL{23}{AK07-J0051-L23}{praeceptis regulae expletis a postremo arcu eo quod arieti et tauro accidet subtracto,}{}
\EdL{24}{AK07-J0051-L24}{reliquum geminorum\textsuperscript{22}) ortum ostendet\textsuperscript{23}). Ex his autem tribus signis determinatis}{}
\EdL{25}{AK07-J0051-L25}{ceterorum etiam\textsuperscript{24}) ortus apparent. Comitantur enim arietem pisces atque libra cum}{}
\EdL{26}{AK07-J0051-L26}{virgine, taurum autem leo atque scorpius cum aquario, geminos autem\textsuperscript{25}) cancer}{}
\EdL{27}{AK07-J0051-L27}{atque capricornus cum sagittario. Haec autem omnia, ut facilius reperiri queant,}{}
\EdL{28}{AK07-J0051-L28}{in sequentibus tabulis secundum \textit{elfelek}\textsuperscript{26}) \textit{elmustakim} descripta sunt. Cuius quidem}{}
\EdL{29}{AK07-J0051-L29}{introitus sic habetur\textsuperscript{27})\,: A capricorno enim incipiens per ortum cuiuslibet gradus}{}
\EdL{30}{AK07-J0051-L30}{cuiusvis signi secundum circulum aequinoctialem, id est \textit{elmustakim}, \textsuperscript{28}) praescriptum in}{}
\EdL{31}{AK07-J0051-L31}{tabulam intra\,; eius autem\textsuperscript{29}) adiunctum horoscopum zodiaci incunctanter\textsuperscript{30}) ostendet.}{}

\EdLp{6}{AK07-J0053-L06}{Ut autem in qualibet regione latitudine non carente differentiam ortus signorum}{}
\EdL{7}{AK07-J0053-L07}{quantum ad circulum aequinoctialem scias, tabula id ipsum determinans supposita}{}
\EdL{8}{AK07-J0053-L08}{est, cuius usus talis est\,: Primo quidem umbra arietis in praesenti regione notanda}{}
\EdL{9}{AK07-J0053-L09}{est\,; deinde per quemlibet gradum in paginam differentiarum intrandum, eiusque}{}
\EdL{10}{AK07-J0053-L10}{adiunctum in umbram praedictam ducendum, atque inde producti arcus inveniendus.}{}
\EdL{11}{AK07-J0053-L11}{Erit igitur ille arcus significans minorationem arietis quantum ad circulum aequi-}{}
\EdL{12}{AK07-J0053-L12}{noctialem pro gradu quidem introducente\,; similiter etiam et piscium\,; librae vero}{}
\EdL{13}{AK07-J0053-L13}{atque virginis additionem. Sequuntur autem arietem cum piscibus in diminutione,}{}
\EdL{14}{AK07-J0053-L14}{licet dissimili, taurus et aquarius, libram vero cum virgine scorpius et leo additione}{}
\EdL{15}{AK07-J0053-L15}{sed dissimili. Sequuntur item taurum cum aquario diminutione sed dissimili gemini}{}
\EdL{16}{AK07-J0053-L16}{et capricornus, scorpium vero cum leone additione sed dissimili cancer et sagittarius.}{}
\EdL{17}{AK07-J0053-L17}{Sicut enim donat aries sua tempora librae, sic cetera quinque suis oppositis, quod}{}
\EdL{18}{AK07-J0053-L18}{retinere nequeunt dimittunt.]\textsuperscript{5})}{}

\EdL{1}{AK07-J0059-L01}{portionis intrandum erit, eiusque adiunctum signandum. Huius itaque adiuncti summa}{}
\EdL{2}{AK07-J0059-L02}{in superationem praedictam\textsuperscript{1}) ducenda erit, quodque\textsuperscript{2}) inde producetur, ei quidem}{}
\EdL{3}{AK07-J0059-L03}{quod in spatio longinquo per argumentum\textsuperscript{3}) latitudinis repertum\textsuperscript{4}) est addendum.}{}
\EdL{4}{AK07-J0059-L04}{Sicque habebitur cuiuslibet eclipsis lunae secundum digitos quantitas definita\textsuperscript{5}).}{}
\EdLp{5}{AK07-J0059-L05}{\textbf{[Scientia examinationis lunarium defectuum.} Cum ergo volueris scire defectus lunae,}{}
\EdL{6}{AK07-J0059-L06}{illam oppositionem excude in qua\textsuperscript{6}) luna caput vel caudam draconis obtineat\textsuperscript{7})\,;}{}
\EdL{7}{AK07-J0059-L07}{argumentum quoque latitudinis | ad horam certam ipsius oppositionis pertinens dili-}{\Marg{N 45\textsuperscript{r}}}
\EdL{8}{AK07-J0059-L08}{genter examinato. Deinde scrutare an sit luna in spatio longinquo. Si enim ibi}{}
\EdL{9}{AK07-J0059-L09}{fuerit, intrabis cum argumento latitudinis in tabulam defectus lunaris longinqui spatii}{}
\EdL{10}{AK07-J0059-L10}{et accipies digitorum quod invenies et dakaicas casus atque \textit{elmuht}\textsuperscript{8}), id est morae,}{}
\EdL{11}{AK07-J0059-L11}{si habuerit \textit{elmuth} (\textit{sic})\textsuperscript{9}). Sin autem fuerit luna in spatio propinquo, intra cum}{}
\EdL{12}{AK07-J0059-L12}{argumento\textsuperscript{10}) latitudinis in tabulam defectus spatio propinquo\textsuperscript{11}), et sume quot\textsuperscript{12}) in}{}
\EdL{13}{AK07-J0059-L13}{eius contrapositione invenies digitorum atque dakaicas \textit{elciicuth}\textsuperscript{13}) atque \textit{elmuht}, si}{}
\EdL{14}{AK07-J0059-L14}{habuerit \textit{elmuht}. Quod si neutro luna extiterit, intra cum argumento\textsuperscript{14}) latitudinis in}{}
\EdL{15}{AK07-J0059-L15}{utramque tabulam. Deinde primum secundo singulis singula sui generis subtrahe,}{}
\EdL{16}{AK07-J0059-L16}{differentiamque inter ea quanta fuerit memoriter teneto. Postremo cum argumento}{}
\EdL{17}{AK07-J0059-L17}{inde examinato\textsuperscript{15}) intrabis in lineas numeri\textsuperscript{16}) tabulae proportionis\textsuperscript{17}) eiusque adiunc-}{}
\EdL{18}{AK07-J0059-L18}{tum accipe\textsuperscript{18}) ex minutis residui\textsuperscript{19}), et per ipsa minuta\textsuperscript{20}) multiplica residuum me-}{}
\EdL{19}{AK07-J0059-L19}{moriae commendatum\textsuperscript{21}), videlicet digitorum et minutorum \textit{elszukut}\textsuperscript{22}) atque \textit{elmuht}.}{}
\EdL{20}{AK07-J0059-L20}{Quod autem inde provenerit, ei quidem quod\textsuperscript{23}) tibi a spatio longinquo exiit\textsuperscript{24}) sin-}{}
\EdL{21}{AK07-J0059-L21}{gula singulis sui generis coacervabis\textsuperscript{25}), eruntque digiti defectus examinati ex dia-}{}
\EdL{22}{AK07-J0059-L22}{metro lunae, eruntque\textsuperscript{26}) dakaicae\textsuperscript{27}) casus et morae examinati (\textit{sic}) \textit{liwacat elcuzuf}\textsuperscript{28}).}{}
\EdL{23}{AK07-J0059-L23}{Postea adde supra \textit{dakaicas}\textsuperscript{29}) casus dimidium sextae eius, dividesque\textsuperscript{30}) illud secun-}{}
\EdL{24}{AK07-J0059-L24}{dum motum lunae horarium\,; quod ergo\textsuperscript{31}) horarum exierit, ipsum est a principio}{}

\FrameHead{0063}{p. 31}{0063}{p. 31}
\EdL{1}{AK07-J0063-L01}{ducendum\,; ipsum itaque productum, si quidem prima radiatio maior fuerit, ei sub-}{}
\EdL{2}{AK07-J0063-L02}{trahendum, si vero minor, e contrario addendum est. Sicque habebitur radiatio}{}
\EdL{3}{AK07-J0063-L03}{praesenti inquisitioni propria. Haec autem omnia pro radiatione sinistra dicta sunt\,;}{}
\EdL{4}{AK07-J0063-L04}{sunt autem et aliae, quas dextras dicunt. Oppositum enim exagoni sinistri trigonum}{}
\EdL{5}{AK07-J0063-L05}{dextrum praetendit\textsuperscript{1})\,; oppositum autem tetragoni sinistri tetragonum dextrum, atque}{}
\EdL{6}{AK07-J0063-L06}{oppositum trigoni sinistri exagonum\textsuperscript{2}) dextrum ostendit.}{}
\EdLp{7}{AK07-J0063-L07}{[Cum volueris scire proiectionem lucis stellarum ex exagono et tetragono et}{}
\EdL{8}{AK07-J0063-L08}{trigono, scias ergo horoscopum et quantum illius ortum fuerit. Quod si fuerint}{}
\EdL{9}{AK07-J0063-L09}{quinque gradus aut X aut XV aut XX aut XXV aut XXX\textsuperscript{3}), scias quoque gradum}{}
\EdL{10}{AK07-J0063-L10}{stellae cuius radiationem quaeris atque signum in quo ipsa est. Postea intra cum}{}
\EdL{11}{AK07-J0063-L11}{gradu ipsius stellae in semitam graduum aequalium de tabula gradus horoscopici,}{}
\EdL{12}{AK07-J0063-L12}{et accipe quod fuerit in eius contrapositione ex horoscopo signi in quo est ipsa stella,}{}
\EdL{13}{AK07-J0063-L13}{ipsumque memoriter teneto. Si ergo quaesieris exagonum, adde supra illud quod}{}
\EdL{14}{AK07-J0063-L14}{est supra caput tabulae ex exagono, et si quaeris tetragonum, adde quod est supra}{}
\EdL{15}{AK07-J0063-L15}{caput trigoni, et si quaesieris trigonum, adde super illud quod est supra caput trigoni.}{}
\EdL{16}{AK07-J0063-L16}{Coacervatum autem quaere eius simile in ipsa tabula, aut quod est affinius illi mi-}{}
\EdL{17}{AK07-J0063-L17}{nusque eo, et ubi inveneris ipsum minus, revertere ad gradus aequales, sicut rever-}{}
\EdL{18}{AK07-J0063-L18}{titur a gradu horoscopi ad gradum aequalem. Scias autem ad quem gradus exieris}{}
\EdL{19}{AK07-J0063-L19}{ex gradibus aequalibus, iste igitur est, in quem cadit radiatio sinistra a stella de}{}
\EdL{20}{AK07-J0063-L20}{signo quod est in supremo tabulae secundum ordinem signorum. Scito autem, quando}{}
\EdL{21}{AK07-J0063-L21}{acciderit stella in postremitate signorum, quod\textsuperscript{4}) est in semita prima, erit coacervatum}{}
\EdL{22}{AK07-J0063-L22}{tibi ex horoscopo, a quo sursum reverti quaeris, maius eo quod est in\textsuperscript{5}) postremitate}{}
\EdL{23}{AK07-J0063-L23}{areae, minue ergo inde numerum qui est in postremitate areae, et quaere residuum}{}
\EdL{24}{AK07-J0063-L24}{in ipsa area, et accipe signum quod est in capite tabulae numeri in semita secunda.}{}
\EdLp{25}{AK07-J0063-L25}{Quod si horoscopus inter V et X, aut inter X et XV, aut inter XV et XX etc.,}{}
\EdL{26}{AK07-J0063-L26}{fac ergo radiationem\textsuperscript{6}) secundum quinque\textsuperscript{7}) quae\textsuperscript{8}) sunt ante id quod est minus,}{}
\EdL{27}{AK07-J0063-L27}{deinde secundum quinque\textsuperscript{9}) quae sunt post id quod est maius\,; sciasque differentiam}{}
\EdL{28}{AK07-J0063-L28}{ipsam. Deinde scito\textsuperscript{10}) quantum addit gradus horoscopi supra quinque\textsuperscript{11}) quae sunt}{}
\EdL{29}{AK07-J0063-L29}{ante, sciasque quae\textsuperscript{12}) est proportio ipsius differentiae ad quinarium, et accipe ipsam}{}
\EdL{30}{AK07-J0063-L30}{proportionem ex differentia quae est inter duos numeros et memoriter teneto. Deinde}{}
\EdL{31}{AK07-J0063-L31}{respice ad radiationem primam, quod\textsuperscript{13}) si addit supra secundam, minue inde quod}{}
\EdL{32}{AK07-J0063-L32}{memoriter teneri iussi\,; sin autem fuerit minus, adde id supra illud. Quod igitur}{}
\EdL{33}{AK07-J0063-L33}{fuerit post augmentum vel\textsuperscript{14}) diminutionem erit radiatio ipsius stellae.}{}
\EdLp{34}{AK07-J0063-L34}{Pro rumoribus horoscopus eiusque dominus, lunae signum eiusque dominus}{}
\EdL{35}{AK07-J0063-L35}{consideranda sunt. Haec namque secundum hoc quod in signis firmis vel non firmis}{}
\EdL{36}{AK07-J0063-L36}{fuerint, rumores affirmant vel infirmant.]\textsuperscript{15})}{}
